integrity.verification_basis: explicit combinatorial proof and standard-library finite checks

scientific_limitations: The exact minimum-generator formula applies to semigroup endomorphisms of the full finite transformation semigroup in degree n >= 5; exceptional degree n = 4 is not included.
Individual original enumeration of all endomorphisms and the structural reduction to two unit-group orbit counts are prior work.
The numerical plane-partition-minus-partition sequence appears previously in OEIS A097391, with a distinct hierarchy interpretation; its numerical values are not claimed to be new.
No sharp asymptotic statement is proved. Computational replay through degree six only cross-checks the infinite combinatorial proof.
Originality is assessed relative to accessible evidence, including the relevant full 2023 primary paper; the 1998 original full paper and a 2023 dissertation could not be inspected in full.
title: A MacMahon correction and an exact minimal-generator formula for endomorphisms of finite transformation monoids
